subject: CRITICAL: GlobalProtect VPN gateway timeout when connecting to Prod
body: Hi team, our remote engineers in London cannot reach the primary VPN portal. GlobalProtect client is reporting tunnel connection timeout and gateway unreachable. We have an active release waiting.
classification_reason: Actionable task categorized under 'Access & Network' based on detected technical indicators.

historical_match.kb_title: GlobalProtect VPN Gateway Timeout on Primary Connection
historical_match.resolution_details: Rerouted user client from overloaded primary gateway to secondary endpoint and flushed stale DNS records.
historical_match.verified_draft:
Hello Marcus Vance,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the VPN connectivity issue. This matches our verified historical incident (TICK-8492) caused by high gateway load on the primary endpoint.

Please follow these verified resolution steps:
1. Open GlobalProtect and go to Settings > Gateway.
2. Switch your gateway address to 'gw-backup.knoxflow.io'.
3. Open terminal/PowerShell and execute: ipconfig /flushdns
4. Re-enter your SSO credentials.

This will re-route your encrypted tunnel through our alternate cluster.

Best regards,
Sarah Connor
KnoxFlow Infrastructure Operations
historical_match.source_verification: 100% Sourced from Historical Resolution Record (No Hallucinated AI Output)

3. Verified upstream synchronization with registry.npmjs.org.

Please re-run your failed GitHub Actions / GitLab pipeline; it should now resolve dependencies cleanly.

Best regards,
